parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat, rectangular surface made of polypropylene plastic, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It is attached to the folding frame and can pivot upward when the chair is folded.

parts.name: Backlegs
parts.Basic_description: The backlegs are tubular aluminum supports forming the rear structural frame of the folding chair.
parts.Functional_description: They provide stability and support to the chair, bearing part of the user's weight and connecting to the seat and backrest.
parts.Movement_description: They pivot around the hinge joint to allow the chair to fold flat for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural frame of the folding chair, typically made of steel tubing.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the seat, backrest, and legs, providing the main load-bearing structure and enabling the folding mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It serves as the pivoting frame that allows the chair to fold and unfold smoothly.
